title: Clinical analyses of immunological and metabolic factors in ME/CFS - the MIRACLE study
summary:
The MIRACLE study is an interdisciplinary research project of the Universities of
Marburg and Regensburg universities, which combines basic and clinical research
to investigate the underlying pathomechanisms of ME/CFS. Myalgic encephalomyelitis / chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) is a disease whose pathophysiological pathophysiological genesis is not yet understood; neither efficient biomarkers
biomarkers or therapies are available. The number of cases of ME/CFS increased significantly again after SARS-CoV-2. In the MIRACLE study, in addition to general data collection, a comprehensive laboratory chemical and scientific investigation is being carried out to examine the inflammatory and metabolic processes of this disease in particular.

interventions.name: 200 persons suffering from ME/CFS are included and data on symptoms, previous therapy, a laboratory panel and examinations (hand strength measurement, standing test, capillary microscopy, HDL analysis, granulocyte function) are carried out

200 persons not suffering from ME/CFS are included and data on symptoms, previous therapy, a laboratory panel and examinations (hand strength measurement, standing test, capillary microscopy, HDL analysis, granulocyte function) are carried out

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Fulfillment of the diagnostic criteria for ME/CFS (collected via online
questionnaire and, in case of doubt, additionally via online consultation)
Exclusion criteria:
Pregnancy
No consent
Age < 18
